annotations.title: Every rail we read, counted in its own unit

description: EVERY RAIL WE READ, COUNTED FROM ITS OWN TABLE, IN ITS OWN UNIT: ACP jobs, Olas mech tasks, x402 payments, Tempo MPP channels, Masumi escrows, and the ERC-8004 and Solana registries (registrations and ratings, kept apart as identity rails). The units are named and never added: a job is not a payment and a channel is not either. Each rail carries chains, events, parties, its span and `scope` (counts, excludes, contracts, first and last block per chain). ON x402, QUOTE THE DATES APART: `from` is the earliest COUNTED row (quarantine excluded), `indexedFrom` the earliest row held with quarantined ones included (how far the index reaches, never the rail’s first payment), and `firstQualifyingEventAt` with `firstQualifyingEvent` {chain, txHash, logIndex, block, evidence} the earliest row carrying x402 evidence, or null with `firstQualifyingReason`; never before `protocolLaunchedAt` (2025-05-06). `events` excludes the `quarantined` rows. The tokens are `scope.includedTokens` (chain, address, symbol, path) and `scope.declaredScope`, generated from that list: not only USDC. An x402 row here is an authorised transfer read from the chain; which are shown to be x402 is the tier answer of payment_evidence. Free.
